name: Silent Nightmare

date.source: The federation's own show-archive index, which files every show by date.

evidence.note: Listed on the federation's own show-archive index; the show's own page was never captured.

The federation's own brief-history recap narrates the card in full: Gravity attacks David Beaumont; the Trents retain the tag titles in a doomsday-style 8-man tag; TR Saxton ends Gravity's career in a 2-out-of-3-falls hardcore match built around thumbtacks, exploding barbed wire, a staple gun, fire, a paring knife, brass knuckles, a chair and a table; Geoffrey Slate escapes a steel cage to become the third North American Champion; Harbinger, with an assist from the returning Gol, beats Pariah a second time, in the course of which Pariah loses a tooth; and the show closes on a phone call from 'The Leader' to David Beaumont. None of this is structured into matches[] because the show itself was never collected.

notes: The federation's own brief-history recap narrates the whole card (see evidence); the show's own results page was never captured, so nothing here is structured into matches[].
